Decide whether the sentence is supported. It is supported only if: the direction and size words fit the figure (a 2% change is not a surge); it does not say or imply that a news event CAUSED a change (saying a change came 'after' an event is fine); it does not present a change that is inside the ordinary band as a real effect of the event; and it states no fact that is missing from the evidence. Reply with one JSON object only: no prose before or after it, no markdown fences. Form: {"verdict": "supported" or "not_supported", "reason": one short sentence}.
